documents.text: The worker queue uses bounded backpressure, a retry budget, and dead-letter isolation.
Release privacy requires a secret scan, path redaction, and a clean publication manifest.
Console recovery verifies process identity, rejects stale state, and retries an occupied loopback port.
Hybrid retrieval combines lexical BM25 rank with local vector similarity and reports both scores.
A pre-action gate may allow, warn, or block; low-trust memories cannot independently block an action.
A structured checkpoint records objective, verified evidence, remaining gaps, next action, and prohibited repetition.
